noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

apiPrefix.description:
Kubernetes API server url prefix, example: /api (default) or /apis
@see https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.22

cloudServiceKind.description: Specific type of cloud service ex: jupyterhub, selenium

cloudServiceEndpoint.description: Endpoint for cloud service ex: jupyter, selenium

templateFieldTypes.description: Field value type of template for K8s resources

templateArrayFields.description: Fields in json that are arrays

immutable.description: The resource can not be updated

workloadResource.description:
Indicates whether this resource is a "Workload Resource", ie, brings up pods when created
@see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/

crd.description: Indicates whether this resource is a "CustomResourceDefinition"

operator.description:
Indicates whether this resource uses the operator pattern
@see https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/extend-kubernetes/operator/
